File contract: Return solution.rs using only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn escape_log_fields(fields: &[String]) -> String
Behavior: Serialize fields separated by a literal tab. Inside each field escape backslash as \\, tab as \t, LF as \n, and CR as \r, in that precedence. An empty list serializes to the empty string.
Visible example: Fields ["a<TAB>b", "c\d"] serialize as a\tb<TAB>c\\d, where <TAB> denotes a literal tab.
